confidence_policy: 100 means verified equality for the stated basis. Other scores are heuristic evidence, not probabilities.

coverage.exact: All successfully hashed files, with byte verification; image equality uses complete normalized still-image pixels.
coverage.visual: DCT radius 12; eight whole-image orientations; center/corner crops at 75% and 50% edges; at most eight candidate views per pair.
coverage.video: Five timestamps per video; sampled visual sequence only. Audio and unsampled frames are not compared.
coverage.relations: Similarities are direct pair relationships, never transitive duplicate groups.
coverage.snapshot: Sources rechecked at scan completion; review revalidates selected content. Concurrent filesystem activity is not an atomic snapshot.
